By

Prices last updated: 
24 May 2026
The bands below are indicative MS ERW (Electric Resistance Welded) pipe prices for orders placed in 
May 2026
, conforming to IS 1239 (Part 1):2004 and IS 3589. They reflect Kanpur wholesale trading that month. Mill origin, if restricted, belongs on the RFQ and is identified in the quotation.
We quote per kilogram (₹/kg), ex-warehouse Kanpur, exclusive of the legally applicable tax stated on the current quotation. The range covers differences in mill source, order quantity, and coil cost. Want a firm delivered-cost quotation? 
Submit your BOQ through our RFQ form
.

All prices shown are indicative price bands based on recent market conditions and are subject to change without notice. Actual quotation depends on quantity, grade, mill source, delivery location, and prevailing market rates. Contact us for a firm quote.
Factors Affecting MS ERW Pipe Pricing
Raw Coil Cost
MS ERW pipes are made from HR coils, and coil inputs move with iron ore, coking coal, and domestic demand. It is the single largest variable in pipe pricing.
Pipe Class (Light / Medium / Heavy)
IS 1239 defines three weight classes. Heavy class pipes have thicker walls, use more steel per metre, and cost more per metre. Copy the class from your approved drawing or tender schedule, not from a generic pressure or load label.
Quantity & Order Pattern
Bundle count, size mix, mill packing, and vehicle utilisation all affect the quoted rate. Send us the complete BOQ instead of asking for one headline quantity discount.
Mill Source & Brand
Mill source can change both the price and the documentation available for inspection. Put any approved-make restriction in your RFQ, and compare offers on the same class, grade, and test basis.
Delivery Destination
Ex-Kanpur bands exclude freight. Your current lane quote depends on the delivery PIN, load weight, vehicle, route, unloading terms, and whether mixed bundles can travel together.
The Right Buyers for IS 1239 MS Pipe in Kanpur
IS 1239 MS ERW pipe shows up in water and plumbing scopes, in gas lines, and in general fabrication, across Kanpur and the surrounding UP industrial belt. The Light, Medium, or Heavy label only identifies a wall-thickness class. It does not by itself establish that a pipe is suitable for a pressure, buried, gas, structural, or fire-service duty. If you are buying for Panki, Dada Nagar, or a public-water project, you should copy the class, grade, finish, joining method, and applicable standard from your approved drawing or tender schedule. Do not infer them from the application name.
Boiler, steam, buried, combustible-gas, and fire-service lines need an engineering specification tied to the governing code. Class selection must account for diameter, grade, design pressure and temperature, corrosion allowance, joint details, external loads, and inspection requirements. Manufacturing process and wall class are separate choices. Send us the approved schedule and drawing with your 
RFQ
 so the quote repeats the engineer's callout rather than substituting a generic rule. Related buying routes: 
steel pipes in Kanpur
, 
MS ERW supply in Kanpur
, and 
steel pipes in Lucknow
.
MS ERW Pipe RFQ Checklist: What Your PO Must State
Most price disputes start from an incomplete PO, not from the market. State every item below so you can check the quotation against the material that arrives.
NB with class:
 nominal bore plus Light, Medium, or Heavy. Class is a wall-thickness designation, not a grade.
Steel grade:
 YST 210, YST 240, or YST 310 as named on the drawing. Whether a given grade and class combination is offered is confirmed in the quotation.
Length and ends:
 the required length and end finish (plain, bevelled, or threaded). A cut length is included only when the quotation names that work.
Finish:
 black, painted, or hot-dip galvanised with the zinc-coating callout under IS 4736 stated separately.
Inspection documents:
 the required mill or inspection certificate, heat traceability, and BIS marking or licence details where applicable.
Inspection:
 whether a named third-party agency will witness loading at the point stated in the quotation.
Packing and delivery basis:
 bundle packing, ex-warehouse Kanpur basis, tax as stated on the current quotation, and freight to the named site if quoted.
Worked Example: Turning a Rs/kg Band Into a Per-Length Cost
Pipe is priced per kilogram but budgeted per length. Take 50 NB Medium class: OD is 60.3 mm and the canonical Medium wall at this bore is 3.60 mm. The site weight formula gives kilograms per metre as (OD minus wall) times wall times 0.02466. That works out to (60.3 minus 3.60) times 3.60 times 0.02466, which is about 5.03 kg per metre. A 6 m length therefore has a theoretical mass of about 30.2 kg.
Apply the table band for 50 NB Medium, Rs 53 to Rs 60 per kg. At 30.2 kg, one 6 m length costs about Rs 1,601 to Rs 1,812 ex-warehouse Kanpur before tax. A historical budgeting illustration dated 24 May 2026 multiplies those figures by an 18% tax input (Rs 1,601 × 1.18 ≈ Rs 1,889; Rs 1,812 × 1.18 ≈ Rs 2,138). That 18% figure is a dated calculation input, not the current legally applicable tax. Use the tax stated on the current quotation, then add the freight quotation for the stated delivery PIN, vehicle, load, and unloading terms. Check the same arithmetic on our 
pipe weight calculator
 before you freeze quantities.
Common Procurement Mistakes on MS ERW Orders
Choosing class from an application shortcut.
 Use the project specification and design calculation; diameter, grade, pressure, temperature, corrosion allowance, joint details, and external loads all affect selection.
Treating class as grade.
 A Heavy-class YST 210 tube is not stronger steel than a Medium-class YST 310 tube. Specify both properties on the PO.
Budgeting the band as the landed cost.
 Bands are ex-warehouse Kanpur and exclude the legally applicable tax and freight stated on the current quotation. Add both before comparing suppliers.
Leaving traceability undefined.
 If the ITP or tender requires heat mapping, state the bundle marking and certificate fields in the PO and verify them before loading.
Assuming mixed loads are automatic.
 Ask the quotation to confirm bundle separation, document mapping, vehicle capacity, and freight for the actual size mix.
Standards and Compliance: IS 1239 and IS 3589 Clauses
IS 1239 Part 1 (formally IS 1239-1:2004) is the BIS specification for welded steel tubes in water, sewage, and gas service. It covers nominal bores from 15 mm to 150 mm in Light, Medium, and Heavy wall classes, in black and galvanised finish. Clause 13.1.1 sets a 5 MPa hydrostatic test for the tubes; this is about 50 kgf per sq cm and is not specific to 50 NB. Request the inspection certificate and heat traceability required by the PO, and verify BIS marking and licence details where applicable.
IS 3589:2001 is a separate specification for steel pipes used for water and sewage, not a structural continuation of the IS 1239 class system. Its scope covers 168.3 to 2540 mm OD and groups supply by manufacturing method, including seamless, ERW, and submerged-arc welded construction, with Fe330, Fe410, and Fe450 grades and a specified wall thickness. Read the clause-level detail on our 
IS 1239 standard reference
, compare the two specs at 
IS 1239 vs IS 3589
, and use the 
IS 1239 class thickness chart
 only for IS 1239 material.
Dispatch From Kanpur to Lucknow, UP Districts and Neighbouring States
If you are writing an RFQ from Panki, Dada Nagar, Jajmau, Coolie Bazar, or the Bartan Bazar market area, you should name the delivery PIN, vehicle constraint, access window, unloading arrangement, and required date. Ask the quotation to identify the offered bundle count, heat, brand, and mill documents for that request. Dispatch timing and last-mile freight are then stated in writing for that load.
If the load is headed to a site in Uttar Pradesh or a neighbouring state, name the destination PIN on the RFQ. The formal quote should then state whether that lane is offered, with dispatch estimate, vehicle and load basis, freight amount, transit basis, unloading responsibility, and quote validity for that request. Mixed classes or pipe families may share a vehicle only when the quotation confirms bundle dimensions, handling, traceability, and capacity. Track the broader sourcing context on our 
Kanpur steel market
 page.
Key Points
MS ERW bands run Rs 47 to Rs 70 per kg ex-warehouse Kanpur across 15 to 150 NB, Light to Heavy.
Match class to the approved specification and design calculation, not to a generic pressure or service shortcut.
A 50 NB Medium 6 m length is about 30.2 kg and budgets about Rs 1,601 to Rs 1,812 before the legally applicable tax.
State NB, class, grade, length, finish, inspection documents, and delivery basis on the PO.
Ask the formal quotation to state offered quantity, freight, dispatch estimate, and transit basis for this request.

Frequently Asked Questions
How often are MS ERW pipe prices updated?
Indicative price bands on this page are revised when coil and mill inputs move. The table gives you a range, not a fixed number. For a firm quote, send us the exact specification, quantity, and delivery PIN.
Why is there a price range instead of a fixed price?
MS ERW pipe pricing depends on raw coil cost, pipe class (light, medium, or heavy), quantity, mill source, and delivery location. The band gives you a realistic budget before you request a formal quotation.
What is the minimum order quantity for MS ERW pipes?
Minimum order, price breaks, and any contract rate depend on your size mix, the mill and packing, and current stock. Send us the BOQ and delivery PIN so the quotation can state the accepted quantity and commercial basis.
Does the price include tax and transport?
No. The prices shown are ex-warehouse Kanpur, exclusive of the legally applicable tax stated on the current quotation. Transport is additional and depends on destination, vehicle, load weight, and unloading terms. Ask us for the delivered-cost basis in the formal quotation.
Which mills can be quoted for MS ERW pipes?
Available mill origin changes with size, class, and current stock. State any approved-make restriction in your RFQ and require the offered make plus applicable inspection documentation to be identified in the quotation.
Can I combine Light, Medium and Heavy class pipes in one truck?
A mixed load of Light, Medium, and Heavy class pipe may be possible when bundle dimensions, vehicle capacity, handling, and documentation remain compatible. List each class and pipe family separately in your BOQ. Your quotation should confirm consolidation, bundle identification, inspection documents, and freight basis.
Sources and References
IS 1239-1:2004, Steel tubes, tubulars and other wrought steel fittings, Part 1: Steel tubes (BIS). Governs classes, dimensions, and the clause 13.1.1 hydrostatic test cited above.
IS 3589:2001, Seamless or electrically welded steel pipes for water and sewage (BIS). Covers the 168.3 to 2540 mm OD range.
NBC 2016, Part 4: Fire and Life Safety (BIS). Use the approved fire-system schedule and authority requirements to select the pipe standard, class, coating, and acceptance documents.
